class.name: DisExerciseControl
class.brief_description: Starts, stops and manages a DIS exercise with Simulation Management PDUs, both as a managed application and as a simulation manager.

method.name: get_frozen_behavior
method.description: Returns the frozen behavior bit field of the last Stop/Freeze that stopped this application (see [constant DisStopFreezePdu.FROZEN_RUN_SIMULATION_CLOCK] and the other [code]FROZEN_*[/code] constants). It is 0 while running. This node only acts on the clock bit; the other bits are for your own code.

method.name: get_pending_requests
method.description: Returns the requests sent by this node that are still waiting for an answer, as an [Array] of [Dictionary] with the keys [code]request_id[/code], [code]acknowledge_flag[/code], [code]receiving_id[/code] ([Vector3i]), [code]sent[/code] (how many times the PDU has been sent) and [code]answers[/code] (how many acknowledgements arrived so far).

method.name: get_scheduled_time
method.description: Returns the real world time, in seconds since the Unix epoch, at which a received Start/Resume or Stop/Freeze will take effect, or [code]0[/code] if none is waiting.

method.name: get_simulation_time
method.description: Returns the simulation time in seconds. It is set from the simulation time of a received Start/Resume and advances every frame while running, or while stopped if the Stop/Freeze set [constant DisStopFreezePdu.FROZEN_RUN_SIMULATION_CLOCK]. It starts at 0.

method.name: handle_pdu
method.description: Handles [param pdu] as if it had been received from the network. Start/Resume, Stop/Freeze, Remove Entity, Create Entity and Acknowledge PDUs are processed; other types are ignored. The node already does this for the PDUs of its [DisNetwork]; use this to feed PDUs from another source.

method.name: is_running
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the state is [constant STATE_RUNNING].

method.name: send_create_entity
method.description: Asks the application [param receiving_id] (site, application, 0) to create an entity by sending a Create Entity PDU, and returns the request ID. Returns [code]0[/code] and prints an error if there is no [DisNetwork] or it is not running. The receiver answers "able to comply" only if its game handles [signal create_entity_requested].

method.name: send_remove_entity
method.description: Asks the owner of the entity [param entity_id] (site, application, entity number) to remove it by sending a Remove Entity PDU, and returns the request ID. An entity number of [constant DisSimulationManagementPdu.ID_ALL] means all entities of that application. Returns [code]0[/code] and prints an error if there is no [DisNetwork] or it is not running.

method.name: send_start_resume
method.description: Sends a Start/Resume PDU and returns the request ID, or [code]0[/code] (with an error) if there is no [DisNetwork] or it is not running. [param receiving_id] is the receiving application as (site, application, 0); the default (65535, 65535, 65535) addresses everyone. [param real_world_time] is when the receivers should start, in seconds since the Unix epoch; [code]0[/code] means at once. [param simulation_time] is the simulation time in seconds the receivers continue from.

method.name: send_stop_freeze
method.description: Sends a Stop/Freeze PDU and returns the request ID, or [code]0[/code] (with an error) if there is no [DisNetwork] or it is not running. [param receiving_id] is the receiving application as (site, application, 0); the default addresses everyone. [param reason] is one of the [code]REASON_*[/code] constants of [DisStopFreezePdu] (default recess). [param frozen_behavior] is a bit field of its [code]FROZEN_*[/code] constants. [param real_world_time] is when the receivers should stop, in seconds since the Unix epoch; [code]0[/code] means at once.

method.name: start
method.description: Sets the state to [constant STATE_RUNNING] by hand, without a PDU, cancels any scheduled change and emits [signal started] (with a [code]null[/code] PDU) and, if the state changed, [signal state_changed]. Unpauses the tree if [member pause_tree] is on.

method.name: stop
method.description: Sets the state to [constant STATE_STOPPED] by hand, without a PDU, with the given [param frozen_behavior] bit field, cancels any scheduled change and emits [signal stopped] (with a [code]null[/code] PDU) and, if the state changed, [signal state_changed]. Pauses the tree if [member pause_tree] is on.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], every request addressed to this application is answered with an Acknowledge PDU: "able to comply", or "unable to comply" for a Remove Entity request that found no entity and a Create Entity request that nothing handles.

How many times a request to a single application is sent again while it is not acknowledged. After the last resend and one more [member retry_interval], [signal request_failed] is emitted. For a request to all applications this only sets how long to wait for answers: [code]max_retries + 1[/code] times [member retry_interval].
Path to the [DisNetwork] to use. If empty, the first node in the group [code]dis_network[/code] is used. Changing it while in the tree reconnects.

If [code]true[/code], stopping pauses the scene tree ([member SceneTree.paused]) and starting unpauses it. This node and its [DisNetwork] are set to [constant Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS] when ready so that a Start/Resume can still arrive; other nodes that should run while paused need that mode too.

If [code]true[/code], a Remove Entity request frees the matching [DisEntity] nodes of this application after [signal remove_entity_requested] is emitted (a [DisEntity] leaving the tree sends its final "deactivated" PDU). If [code]false[/code] only the signal is emitted and your code removes the entity.
Time in seconds between sending a request again.
If [code]true[/code], the node stops when it is ready and waits for a Start/Resume.

signal.name: acknowledged
signal.description: Emitted when an Acknowledge PDU for a request sent by this node arrives. [param request_id] is the request ID returned by the send method, [param response_flag] is the response of the receiver (see the [code]RESPONSE_*[/code] constants of [DisAcknowledgePdu], for example able or unable to comply) and [param pdu] is the Acknowledge PDU. For a request to all applications this is emitted once per answering application.

signal.name: create_entity_requested
signal.description: Emitted when a Create Entity PDU addressed to this application arrives (not for a repeat of the same request). [param pdu] is the request. Create the entity in your game. If nothing is connected to this signal the request is answered "unable to comply".

signal.name: remove_entity_requested
signal.description: Emitted for each [DisEntity] of this application that a Remove Entity PDU asks to remove (not for a repeat of the same request), before the node is freed. [param entity_id] is the effective entity ID of the [DisEntity] and [param pdu] is the request.

signal.name: request_failed
signal.description: Emitted when a request sent by this node got no answer after all retries. [param request_id] is the request ID returned by the send method.

signal.name: started
signal.description: Emitted when the application starts or resumes, by a received Start/Resume PDU or by [method start]. [param pdu] is the [DisStartResumePdu], or [code]null[/code] when started by hand or by [member start_stopped].

signal.name: state_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the state changes between running and stopped. [param state] is the new [enum State].

signal.name: stopped
signal.description: Emitted when the application stops or freezes, by a received Stop/Freeze PDU or by [method stop]. It is emitted even if it was already stopped. [param pdu] is the [DisStopFreezePdu], or [code]null[/code] when stopped by hand or by [member start_stopped].

constants.constant: The simulation is stopped or frozen.
